email_subject: Possible adverse event report - DemoCardolol patient with severe abdominal pain radiating to the back
email_body:
[SYNTHETIC / FICTIONAL DATA — educational prototype only, no real patient or reporter information]

Hello Safety Team,


I am a clinical care coordinator at Fictional General Hospital (demo) (a fabricated organization) and I would like to report a possible adverse event.

A 38-year-old male patient with a history of hypertension received their second dose of DemoCardolol via subcutaneous injection.
Treatment started on 2026-06-04.
Approximately 3 day(s) after that dose, the patient developed severe abdominal pain radiating to the back.
The patient was hospitalized as a result.

Please let me know if you need anything else.

Regards,
J. Silva (fictional reporter)
Fictional General Hospital (demo)
Contact: demo.reporter663@fictionalclinic-demo.example (synthetic contact info)
